slides.title: Have a Rest Card?
slides.vo: Hey! Have a Rest Card? Let me show you how to use it and give your lowest-step day a boost!

slides.title: Check your impact
slides.vo: Step 2. Check your potential impact. I'll show you how your step count, contest deficit and club placement could change after applying the card.

slides.title: Tap Apply Rest Card
slides.vo: Step 3. Happy with the impact? Tap Apply Rest Card.

slides.title: Low benefit? Choose
slides.vo: Before applying, I'll check whether this card will make a meaningful difference to your progress. If the benefit is low, I'll let you know, and you can choose whether to apply it or save it for later.

slides.title: No benefit? Save it
slides.vo: If there's no benefit, you can save your card for another time.

slides.title: Found for you
slides.vo: Step 4. If you proceed, I'll automatically scan your contest history, find your lowest eligible step day and apply the card to it. You don't have to search for or select the day yourself!

slides.title: Lowest day boosted
slides.vo: And that's it! Your lowest day gets a boost, your total contest steps increase and your deficit comes down. Easy, right?

slides.title: Keep building consistency
slides.vo: Now get back out there and keep building that consistency. I'll be right here cheering you on!
